label: Countable carrier with infinite event and complement admits every interior event probability
paraphrase: On every countable carrier with measurable singletons, an event that is infinite and has an infinite complement receives each strictly interior probability from some normalized measure giving positive mass to every point. Carrier and event cardinality do not fix the probability; a probability is not thereby shown unavailable.
